source: Guilda: I don't think he realizes. Ophelia: Hamlet. Think upon it a moment. What did you mean when you said you found that sort of woman to be tiresome? Hamlet: Women like 'her.' The lily-faced, fair-haired sort who loudly protest every whim. And Danish women who look like her are all that way. Merely being near women like that is exhausting. I far prefer the company of women of your nature. You know. real women. Ophelia: And so—you feel that 'all women' like myself and Lady Guildenstern are somehow—different? Hamlet: Of course. Isn't that clear? You sort are far kindlier, with greater cheer and a captivating graciousness. Guilda: Graciousness? Is that what you call it? At Wittenberg, women who looked like Ophelia and me were afraid to refuse you. You're a Prince.
target: 吉尔妲: 我觉得他还没意识到。 奥菲莉娅: 哈姆雷特。好好想一想。你说觉得那种女人很烦人，是什么意思？ 哈姆雷特: 像“她”那样的女人。皮肤白皙、头发浅色，随便提个念头就要大声反对的那种。长得像她的丹麦女人全都这样。 光是待在那种女人身边就够累的。我更喜欢和你们这样的女人相处。你们懂的，真正的女人。 奥菲莉娅: 所以——你觉得，像我和吉尔登斯吞女士这样的女人，“全都”跟她们——不一样？ 哈姆雷特: 当然。这还不明显吗？你们这类女人要和善得多，更开朗，还那么温和有礼，令人着迷。 吉尔妲: 温和有礼？你是这么称呼的？ 在维滕贝格，长得像奥菲莉娅和我这样的女人，不敢拒绝你。你是王子。

source: Guilda: And if one of us was to spurn your advances, and you were to become angry for it? Well, then. Hamlet: I would never begrudge a woman for something like that! Ophelia: Oh, never? Come now, Hamlet. Hamlet: ... Guilda: Do not mistake fear for graciousness, Hamlet. Or you're more the fool than I ever thought. We may be landed, styled women, but we are not equal to you. Not in this world. Not in Denmark. And you used that against us to find your next match. Ophelia: What she says is the truth. It is the reason I told you never to speak to me again.
target: 吉尔妲: 如果我们中有人拒绝你的追求，而你又为此动怒呢？那可就…… 哈姆雷特: 我绝不会因为这种事怨恨一个女人！ 奥菲莉娅: 哦，绝不会？得了吧，哈姆雷特。 哈姆雷特: ... 吉尔妲: 别把恐惧当成温和有礼，哈姆雷特。不然，你就比我想的还要蠢。 我们虽有土地、有头衔，却不能与你平起平坐。在这个世界如此，在丹麦也如此。 而你就利用我们的弱势，物色你的下一个伴侣。 奥菲莉娅: 她说的是实话。我就是因此才告诉你，再也别跟我说话。

source: Ophelia: It is all too easy for you to ruin us. And we know this. It is only you who remain blind to it. Hamlet: Clearly I've made a great number of women uncomfortable. Am I truly so blind to this element of the world, then? You're both right. I have this power, whether I ever wanted it or not. And I was too absorbed within myself to see it.
target: 奥菲莉娅: 你要毁了我们，实在太容易了。 而我们知道这一点。只有你还浑然不觉。 哈姆雷特: 显然，我让很多女人感到不自在。 难道我对这个世界的这一面，真的如此无知吗？ 你们两个说得对。无论我是否想要，我都拥有这种权力。而我太沉浸在自己的世界里，没能看清这一点。
